ita ārabhya sarveṣāṃ
kārakāṇāṃ viṃśatitamaślokasthe apaśyadityatra krameṇānvayaḥ

bhūtamaṇḍalākhyo deśabhedastasya paryantaḥ sīmā tatratyagrāmasya upānte
saṃnihitabhūmau nivāsinām
sārameyāḥ śvāna eva mṛgayādyarthaṃ parīvāro yasya
navatvādeveṣṭayā navaṃ nityāminavaṃ yathā syāttathā iṣṭayā vā

bhūtagraho bhūtamaṇḍalākhyo deśastadīyagrāmasaṃbandhinīṃ
janmabhūmimupetya dūre tālādiparṇairmaṭhikāṃ kuṭīṃ kṛtvā sthitam

jīrṇaprāyā rasā yasya tathāvidhena
śvabhortpannatamālatāruṇā saṃnibhaṃ sadṛśam
krūrāṇi nāmānyākhyā arthāḥ kriyāvacanāni ca yasya

athānantaraṃ bhramahāriṇaḥ
bhrāntimevānuvartamānasya kalatriṇaḥ kuṭumbinaḥ svātmanaḥ svasya
yāvatkalatraṃ kuṭumbamabhūttanmṛtyunā āvṛtya aśeṣeṇa niḥśeṣatayā
nītamapaśyaditi dvayoranvayaḥ

yathā āsārasalilena vṛṣṭijalapravāheṇa
vanapatitaśuṣkaparṇagaṇo nīyate tadvadityarthaḥ
athāsau jaraṭha eka eva aṭavyāṃ pralapati roditi

nṛtyato ratnairaṃśukaiśca cchannā mārgasthā vṛkṣā latā aṅganāśca
yasmiṃstathāvidhaṃ rājamārgamadhyamavāpeti pareṇānvayaḥ

nānāvarṇamaṇiṣu
pratibimbanāttattatprabhābhiḥ prabhāto'rko yāsu tathāvidhāḥ velāḥ
svataṭasthamacalaṃ girimiva

nago girirdhātubhirlakṣaṇayā dhātusaṃbandhibhiḥ prabhājālairabhramākāśaṃ
meghamiva vā

tā prakṛtayaḥ saiṃhe āsane upaveśya
kramādbrāhmaṇādivarṇakramādabhiṣiṣicuḥ

abhiṣicya ca tasminprāgukte gaje
upaveśyānujagmurita śeṣaḥ

hariṇā siṃhena hatādvidāritātkarikumbhādunmuktānāṃ muktāphalānāṃ
kalāpaiḥ praviracitaṃ bhūṣitaṃ śarīraṃ yasya

śāntāḥ prāktana cintā
viṣādāśca yasya tathāvidhaḥ saṃstatra nagare sadbhirmantripaurādibhiḥ saha
bhogairaramata reme

yathā ravikarairmadena ca tapta ibhaḥ sarasyāṃ vāripūrai
ramate tadvat

ata eva sarvadikṣu saṃsthitā
ājñā yasya

katipayadivasairīhayā svecchayaiva siddhā rājyavyavasthā yasya sa
śvapaco gavala ityabhinavena nāmnā prasiddhastatra kīradeśe rājā
babhūvetyarthaḥ
